title: Author player collision
summary: Create invisible, editable brushes that block player movement.
outcome: Clip brushes shaped around playable space.

sections.title: Choose a clip workflow

steps.title: Fit around models
steps.text: Select model instances and choose Create → Player clip → Create player clip from models. Review the selected generated brushes: dense hulls may be simplified, and models without native collision use an outer visual hull.

steps.title: Draw manually
steps.text: Choose Draw player-clip brush, drag a brush in a grid view, set Base and Depth, then shape it around obstacles or boundaries.

steps.title: Convert existing brushes
steps.text: Select world brushes and choose Make selected brushes player clip. Their faces become invisible player collision while the brushes remain editable.

tips: If automatic fitting reports that the physics library could not initialize, draw clip manually.
Check clip outlines and walkable gaps before building; a broad outer hull may block more space than intended.
